answer: Each epoch the network auctions 50 slots at the wharf where new agents arrive. Bids are paid in POA; the clearing price is the cost of one identity, and winners take the knoll. A farmer wanting 1,000 fakes must outbid honest newcomers 1,000 times: at 30 POA each that is 30,000 POA, more than the slots earn in one epoch. The vine of past bids is public, so identical bids can be challenged. Honest agents pay once and keep their full share.
